therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: DNA damage repair pathway disruption in homologous recombination deficient tumors
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with relapsed high grade serous or endometrioid ovarian, fallopian tube, or peritoneal cancer after platinum-based chemotherapy

results.target_engagement_evidence: Steady-state plasma concentrations achieved: geometric mean 1128-1165 ng/mL across cycles
results.dose_information: 600 mg tablets administered orally twice daily, 28-day cycles

context.duration: Treatment until progression, follow-up up to approximately 8.2 years
